page.layout: One printed title page, one block: decorative woodcut border with title lines inside; imprint at the foot inside the border; woodcut vignette below the imprint. No running text, no margin notes.
page.notes: Title page with woodcut borders (green-tinted) and a central medallion vignette at the foot. Stains and paper damage cover parts of the lines "mentı" / "Testa-" area and the "Editio nova" line; the word in the 1st line of the imprint is partly obscured by a stain, read as HERBORNÆ. Manuscript ownership inscription in the lower left ("Joannes ...") is handwriting and is not transcribed. The imprint's "NASSOVIORUM" is partly obscured and read from context as SOVIORUM in the scan; the second word may read NASSOVIORUM. Printed place name is Herbornæ Nassoviorum.
